patterns: APPSC asks single facts: first dynasty of Andhra = Satavahanas, earliest inscriptions in Maharashtra, Anupa capital = Mahishmati.
Queens recur: Devi Naganika as regent (distractors Gautami Balasri, Lilavati); Nasik Prasasti by Gautami Balasri.
Scholar-theory matching on origin (Sukthankar, Bhandarkar) and 'which work does NOT narrate early history' (Gathasaptasati) are APPSC favourites.
First land grants to Brahmanas/Buddhists = Satavahanas; Matsya Purana has the longest king list.
App adds many title-meaning and inscription-matching statement items; a few rest on source-disputed attributions.
